camel_example: aliyun dbs CreateAndStartBackupPlan --region cn-hangzhou --BackupMethod logical --BackupPlanName dbstooi00000000 --DatabaseType MySQL --InstanceClass micro --SourceEndpointInstanceType RDS
description_en: Creates, configures, and starts a backup plan
description_zh: 该接口用于创建、配置并启动备份计划
kebab_example: aliyun dbs create-and-start-backup-plan --instance-class micro --database-type MySQL --backup-method logical --source-endpoint-instance-type RDS --backup-plan-name dbstooi00000000 --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAndStartBackupPlan

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup plan
parameters.help_zh: 备份计划ID
parameters.name: backup_plan_id

parameters.help_en: The region where DBS is available. To view the available regions, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869853.html operation
parameters.help_zh: DBS支持地域，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869853.html接口查看
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The specification of the backup plan. Valid values:

micro

small

medium

large

xlarge

Higher specifications provide better backup and recovery performance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84372.html
parameters.help_zh:
备份计划的规格，取值：
micro
small
medium
large
xlarge

规格越高，备份与恢复的性能越高。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84372.html
parameters.name: instance_class

parameters.help_en:
The database type. Valid values:

MySQL

MSSQL

Oracle

MariaDB

PostgreSQL

DRDS

MongoDB

Redis
parameters.help_zh:
数据库类型，取值：
MySQL
MSSQL
Oracle
MariaDB
PostgreSQL
DRDS
MongoDB
Redis
parameters.name: database_type

parameters.help_en:
The backup method. Valid values:

logical: logical backup

physical: physical backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份方式，取值：
logical：逻辑备份
physical：物理备份
parameters.name: backup_method

parameters.help_en:
The billing cycle of the subscription instance. Valid values:

Year

Month
parameters.help_zh:
指定预付费实例为包年或者包月类型，取值：
Year：包年
Month：包月
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. Valid values:

If Period is set to Year, the value of UsedTime can be 1 to 5.

If Period is set to Month, the value of UsedTime can be 1 to 11
parameters.help_zh:
指定购买时长，取值：
当参数Period为Year时，UsedTime取值为1~5。
当参数Period为Month时，UsedTime取值为1~11
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en:
The payment method. Valid value:

prepay: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
支付方式，取值：

 prepay：预付费（包年包月）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en: The region where the database is located
parameters.help_zh: 数据库地域
parameters.name: database_region

parameters.help_en: The storage region
parameters.help_zh: 存储地域
parameters.name: storage_region

parameters.help_en:
The database instance type. Valid values:

RDS

PolarDB

DDS: Alibaba Cloud MongoDB

Kvstore: Alibaba Cloud Redis

Other: A database connected over an IP address and port.

dg: A self-managed database without a public IP address or port, connected through Database Gateway (DG)
parameters.help_zh:
数据库实例类型，取值：
RDS
PolarDB
DDS：阿里云MongoDB
Kvstore：阿里云Redis
Other：通过IP:Port接入的数据库
dg：无公网IP:Port的自建数据库（通过数据库网关DG接入）
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not yet available
parameters.help_zh: 该参数暂未开放使用
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en: The source of the request. The default value is OpenApi. You do not need to set this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 用于备注请求来源，默认值为OpenApi，无需手动设置
parameters.name: from_app

parameters.help_en:
The location of the database. Valid values:

RDS

ECS

Express: A database connected through a leased line, VPN Gateway, or Smart Access Gateway.

Agent: A database connected through a backup gateway.

DDS: Alibaba Cloud MongoDB

Other: A database connected directly over an IP address and port.

dg: A self-managed database without a public IP address or port, connected through Database Gateway (DG)
parameters.help_zh:
数据库所在位置，取值：
RDS
ECS
Express：通过专线/VPN网关/智能网关接入的数据库
Agent：通过备份网关接入的数据库
DDS：云MongoDB
Other：通过IP:Port直连的数据库
dg：无公网IP:Port的自建数据库（通过数据库网关DG接入）
parameters.name: source_endpoint_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The region where the database is located.

This parameter is required if SourceEndpoint.InstanceType is set to RDS, ECS, DDS, Express, or Agent
parameters.help_zh:
数据库地域。
SourceEndpoint.InstanceType为RDS、ECS、DDS、Express、Agent时，该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_region

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the database instance.

This parameter is required if SourceEndpoint.InstanceType is set to RDS, ECS, DDS, or Express
parameters.help_zh:
数据库实例ID。

SourceEndpoint.InstanceType为RDS、ECS、DDS、Express时，该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The database endpoint.

This parameter is required if SourceEndpoint.InstanceType is set to express, agent, or other
parameters.help_zh:
数据库连接地址。

SourceEndpoint.InstanceType为express、agent、other时，该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_ip

parameters.help_en:
The database port.

This parameter is required if SourceEndpoint.InstanceType is set to express, agent, other, or ECS
parameters.help_zh:
数据库端口。

SourceEndpoint.InstanceType为express、agent、other、ECS时，该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_port

parameters.help_en:
The database name.

This parameter is required if the database type is PostgreSQL or MongoDB
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名称。

数据库类型为PostgreSQL、MongoDB时，该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_database_name

parameters.help_en:
The database account.

This parameter is optional if the database type is Redis, or if the database location is agent and the database type is MSSQL. In all other cases, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号。

数据库类型为Redis，或者数据库所在位置为agent且数据库类型为MSSQL时该参数非必须，其他场景均必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_user_name

parameters.help_en:
The password for the database account.

This parameter is optional if the database type is Redis, or if the database location is agent and the database type is MSSQL. In all other cases, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
密码。

数据库类型为Redis，或者数据库所在位置为agent且数据库类型为MSSQL时该参数非必须，其他场景均必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_password

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup gateway.

This parameter is required if SourceEndpoint.InstanceType is set to agent.

For more information about how to create a backup gateway, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93250.html.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869840.html operation to view the list of existing backup gateways
parameters.help_zh:
备份网关ID。

SourceEndpoint.InstanceType为agent时，该参数必传。
如何创建备份网关，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93250.html。
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869840.html查看已有备份网关列表
parameters.name: backup_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket.
Default: The system automatically generates a new name
parameters.help_zh:
OSS Bucket名称。
默认：系统自动生成新的名称
parameters.name: oss_bucket_name

parameters.example: [     {         "DBName":"待备份库名",         "SchemaName":"待备份 Schema 名",         "TableIncludes":[{             "TableName":"待备份表表名"         }],         "TableExcludes":[{             "TableName":"待备份库名不需要备份表的表名"         }]     } ]
parameters.help_en: The backup objects
parameters.help_zh: 备份对象
parameters.name: backup_objects

parameters.help_en:
The full backup cycle. Valid values:

Monday

Tuesday

Wednesday

Thursday

Friday

Saturday

Sunday

You can select multiple values. Separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
全量备份周期，取值：
Monday：周一
Tuesday：周二
Wednesday：周三
Thursday：周四
Friday：周五
Saturday：周六
Sunday：周日

支持选择多个取值，用英文逗号（,）分开
parameters.name: backup_period

parameters.help_en: The start time for the full backup. The time is in the HH:mm format and is in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 全量备份开始时间，格式为HH:mm（UTC时间）
parameters.name: backup_start_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable incremental log backup. Valid values:

true

false
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启增量日志备份，取值：
true：开启
false：关闭
parameters.name: enable_backup_log

parameters.help_en:
The interval for incremental backups, in seconds.

This parameter is required only for physical backups
parameters.help_zh:
增量时间间隔，以秒（s）为单位。
仅选择物理备份时需要传入该参数
parameters.name: backup_log_interval_seconds

parameters.help_en: The retention period for backup data, in days. Valid values: 0 to 1825. Default value: 730
parameters.help_zh: 备份数据保留时间，取值：0~1825，默认为730天
parameters.name: backup_retention_period

parameters.help_en: The time after which backup data is converted to Infrequent Access (IA) storage, in days. Default value: 180
parameters.help_zh: 转为低频访问存储时间，默认为180天
parameters.name: duplication_infrequent_access_period

parameters.help_en: The time after which backup data is converted to archive storage, in days. Default value: 365
parameters.help_zh: 转为归档冷备存储时间，默认为365天
parameters.name: duplication_archive_period

parameters.help_en: The custom name of the backup plan
parameters.help_zh: 自定义备份计划名称
parameters.name: backup_plan_name

parameters.help_en: The Oracle system ID (SID). This parameter is required if the database type is Oracle
parameters.help_zh: Oracle SID名称，数据库类型为Oracle时，该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_oracle_sid

parameters.help_en:
The built-in storage type:

Empty (default): Backup data is stored in your OSS bucket.

system: Backup data is stored in the built-in OSS bucket of DBS
parameters.help_zh:
内置存储类型：
空（默认）：备份数据存储在用户OSS上。
system ：备份数据存储在DBS的内置OSS上
parameters.name: backup_storage_type

parameters.help_en:
The disk I/O limit, in KB/s.

This parameter is valid only for MySQL physical backups
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘IO限制， 单位为KB/s。
该参数仅对MySQL物理备份生效
parameters.name: backup_speed_limit

parameters.help_en:
The network bandwidth throttling limit, in KB/s. The maximum allowed value is 10 GB.

This parameter is valid only for MySQL physical backups
parameters.help_zh:
网络带宽限制，单位为KB/s，最大允许10 GB。
该参数仅对MySQL物理备份生效
parameters.name: backup_rate_limit

parameters.help_en:
The full backup strategy. Valid values:

simple: periodic backup. Use this value with BackupPeriod and BackupStartTime.

manual: manual backup.

The default value is simple
parameters.help_zh:
全量备份周期，取值：
simple：周期备份，和BackupPeriod、BackupStartTime配合使用。
manual：手动备份。

默认为simple
parameters.name: backup_strategy_type

parameters.help_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account for cross-account backup
parameters.help_zh: 跨阿里云账号备份的UID
parameters.name: cross_aliyun_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM role for cross-account backup
parameters.help_zh: 跨阿里云账号备份的RAM角色名称
parameters.name: cross_role_name

parameters.help_en: A client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. This prevents duplicate requests
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id
